concise.text: Collect the form from any Divisional Secretariat, or download it from the department's website.

detailed.text: Get the application form from the Registrar Division of any Divisional Secretariat, or download it from the website of the Registrar General's Department. You can collect it from any office; you submit it later to the one for the place of birth.

text.text: You do not have to collect it from the office where you will submit it: the Registrar Division of any Divisional Secretariat can give it to you.

detailed.text: Complete the application for the Divisional Secretariat of the place of birth. If you know the birth certificate number and registration date, give them: this decides which charge applies, because a search of the records costs more than a copy from a known entry.

text.text: If you are not sure of the number or date, you can still apply; you then follow the search route in the next step.
